summary: PayPal's main friction themes include poor user experience with frequent app updates, security and account access issues, fraud and scam concerns, and declining trust in the platform.

themes.name: Declining Trust
themes.description: Users feel PayPal is prioritizing profit over user experience and security, leading to a loss of trust and a shift to alternatives.
themes.recommendation: Reinforce transparency, improve customer support, and align updates with user needs.

quotes.text: And of course everyone trusts that PayPal won't be hacked. /s
Some people believe PayPal's fraud detection was really really good.

themes.name: Poor User Experience
themes.description: Users consistently report that the app has become more complicated and less intuitive, with excessive ads and a cluttered interface that makes it harder to manage transactions and access key features.
themes.recommendation: Revert to previous UI design, reduce ads, and improve navigation.

quotes.text: Poor App Design. The new app design is full of useless advertisements and they have made it more difficult to find the information you need to monitor your transactions.

themes.name: Fraud and Scam Concerns
themes.description: Users report fraudulent activity, account closures without explanation, and difficulty getting support for disputed transactions, leading to distrust and financial loss.
themes.recommendation: Enhance fraud detection, improve dispute resolution processes, and provide clearer communication during account issues.

themes.name: Security and Account Access Issues
themes.description: Users face difficulties logging in due to account lockouts, password reset failures, and security questions that were never set, leading to frustration and loss of access.
themes.recommendation: Improve account recovery options, reduce false lockouts, and enhance security without compromising usability.
